intro.title: Your passwords, on your server
intro.text: End-to-end encrypted: only your devices can read them – not the server, not an administrator. Works offline and syncs without the VPN.

setup.title: Set up Vault
setup.pwText: It opens your vault on all devices. It never leaves this device – not even the GateControl server knows it.
setup.pwRule: At least 12 characters and not weak – a few random words work well.
setup.warnText: Not even an administrator. In the next step you get a recovery key – without it, your data is lost if you forget the password.
setup.doneText: Choose how you open Vault on this PC.

recovery.text: With it you get into your vault if you forget the master password. It is shown only this once.
recovery.tip1: Print it and keep it with your important papers.

recovery.tip3: You can also name trusted people for emergency access later.

remember.title: Stay signed in

hello.title: Unlock with Windows Hello
hello.text: Vault opens with your face, fingerprint or PIN through Windows Hello. The key stays with Windows (in the security chip when the PC has one); the master password is not stored. Anyone who knows your Windows PIN can then open Vault on this PC as well.
hello.rememberOff: Not together with Windows Hello – Windows Hello asks for you every time.
hello.blocked: Too many Windows Hello attempts. Unlock with your master password this time.
hello.confirmText: Confirm with your master password. Windows then asks for your face, fingerprint or PIN – possibly twice.

vault.note: Vault folder – end-to-end encrypted, readable on approved devices only

gate.title: Vault folder
gate.none: This folder is end-to-end encrypted. This PC has no key for it yet. Ask for access – an approved device confirms it – or open the vault with its recovery key.
gate.revoked: This PC's access was removed. You can ask again or enter the recovery key.
gate.pending: Access requested. Confirm it on an approved device (e.g. in the portal or the app) and compare this safety number there:
gate.unsupported: This PC cannot store keys protected (Windows data protection/DPAPI not available) – vault folders cannot be opened here.

safety.same: The number matches the one on the other device

recovery.title: Recovery key
recovery.intro: “{{name}}” has been created. Write down this recovery key and keep it safe. It is shown only now.
recovery.newIntro: The vault has a new key and a new recovery key. Write it down – it is shown only now; the old one no longer works.
recovery.label: Recovery key
recovery.warn: Without it nobody can reach the files once every approved device is lost – not even an administrator.
recovery.kept: I have written the key down

create.title: New vault folder
create.intro: Contents and names are encrypted on your devices. The server never sees them. No previews, search, links or office for this folder.

recover.title: Open with recovery key
recover.intro: Enter the 56 characters shown when the vault was created. This PC is approved with it.

rotate.why: Someone no longer has access to this area. A new key protects new files.
rotate.title: Create a new key
rotate.intro: New files and names are then encrypted with the new key; every approved device gets it. Older files stay readable.
